live.title: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Keynote

live.title: Customer Testimonial: The ODP Group (Office Depot) | Mick Feller
live.description: Mick Feller, Distinguished Software Engineer at The ODP Group (Office Depot), on powering an enterprise AI Personal Assistant with Azure Cosmos DB.

live.description: Sid Anand, Technical Fellow at Walmart, uses the Jetsons' Spacely Sprockets as a fun lens for the best practices behind always-on, low-latency, cost-efficient Cosmos DB apps.

live.title: Performance-Boosting Memory Patterns: Save Tokens, Cut Costs, Increase Speed

live.title: Powering Azure Cosmos DB with AMD EPYC | Andrew Ruffin

live.title: Customer Testimonial: SOUTHWORKS | Johnny Halife

live.title: Data Modeling Decisions That Make or Break Your Cosmos DB Application
live.description: Strategies for partition keys, schema design, storage estimation, and managing cross-partition queries before the choices become painful to fix.
